Consuelo OS gives agents a shared way to do work. The pieces are deliberately separate:

| Piece | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| **Tool** | Performs one typed operation, such as reading a file or opening a page. |
| **Skill** | Teaches an agent when and how to combine tools and scripts for a kind of work. |
| **Script** | Contains executable implementation behind a tool or skill. |
| **Steering** | Supplies durable workspace rules and decision guidance. |
| **Workflow** | Selects an ordered bundle of roles and tools for a repeated process. |
| **Context** | Saves or retrieves durable notes and trace-backed history. |
| **Artifact** | Stores a versioned output with provenance back to the work that produced it. |
| **Approval** | Stops sensitive work before execution until an approved path is used. |

## The normal path

```text
get_steering
  → discover a tool or load a skill
  → call typed tools
  → produce files or artifacts
  → inspect the trace
```

Start an agent session with `get_steering`. Use `tools.search` when the needed operation is not already visible, then call the selected tool with typed input. Load a skill when the task needs a proven operating procedure rather than one isolated operation.

Consuelo OS is in preview. These pages describe current verified behavior and call out places where a self-service path does not exist yet.
